proof_origin.place: Tag 08EU, locality of isomorphisms of the projection map; implemented via exact restriction, cohomology, and the existing open-cover locality theorem for module sheaves.

derived category isomorphism restriction open cover

proof.text: Apply the proved Mathlib criterion DerivedCategory.isIso_iff to the morphism phi. It suffices to show that each integer-degree cohomology map is an isomorphism. This criterion applies to the unbounded derived category of sheaves of modules, without boundedness or quasi-coherence assumptions.

For each cover member U_i, apply cohomology to the given isomorphism of derived restrictions. The exact functor comparison schemeOpenRestriction.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso identifies this map with the restriction of the global cohomology map. The open restriction is overFunctor followed by Scheme.Modules.overEquiv; reflect isomorphisms through that equivalence to obtain an isomorphism of the over-site restriction of the cohomology map. The comparison is the proved exact-functor cohomology comparison, descended to the localization by quasi-isomorphisms.

The pointwise covering hypothesis gives iSup U_i = top. Apply sheaf_module_isIso_iff_isIso_over_open_cover to the cohomology map, using the local isomorphisms from the preceding step. This proves each global cohomology map invertible, hence phi invertible by the first step.

lean.statement: theorem projectionFormula_local_to_global (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (I : Type v) (U : I → Y.Opens) (hcover : ∀ y : Y, ∃ i : I, y ∈ U i) (φ : ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E) ⊗ K ⟶ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (E ⊗ ((derivedPullback f).obj K))) : (∀ i : I, IsIso ((schemeOpenRestriction Y (U i)).mapDerivedCategory.map φ)) → IsIso φ
